messages:
Erin (Partnerships): Heads-up: LangChain asked for a single "bundle" we can hand them: marketplace package + SI-friendly gateway/orchestrator onboarding. Need a scoped deliverable list. :memo:

Vik (Eng Integrations): Minimal bundle idea: quickstart repo, CI smoke tests, marketplace manifest, SI deployment checklist (mTLS/OIDC + helm). Keep it lightweight.

Noah (DevEx): I'll scaffold a quickstart repo w/ README, GH Action to run smoke tests, and a sample terraform snippet for a small Dedicated stack.

Priya (Solutions Eng): For SI installs, include: network diagram, cert steps, example OIDC mapping, and monitoring hooks (Prom + tracing). Also a short runbook for common firewall issues.

ci-bot: Created ticket PART-4517 (owner: Noah)

Erin (Partnerships): Good. Let's standardize the smoke tests runnable in CI: auth handshake (API key + OIDC), sync generate, streaming smoke, embedding vector check, and fallback routing. Tests should be runnable with a single env var.

Vik (Eng Integrations): I'll provide a small test harness and a `simulate-fallback` test that triggers a graceful downgrade to a smaller model. Example smoke call:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-mini","input":"ping"}'
```

Lina (Product): Proposal: a "Verified" badge if partner passes our harness (95th pct latency threshold) and follows marketplace metadata rules. We'll publish the badge criteria.

Noah (DevEx): I'll add a validation GH Action that can run on partner PRs. Also include a sample dataset + deterministic prompts so results are reproducible.

Priya (Solutions Eng): For demos, draft a canonical flow (app -> gateway chains tools -> orchestrator -> traces). Partners should rehearse with us; we'll provide a 30-min dry run checklist.

Erin (Partnerships): Assignments: Noah = quickstart repo + CI; Vik = test harness + infra SKUs; Priya = SI checklist + demo script; Lina = badge policy & marketplace copy; Erin = partner comms and scheduling. Target: draft bundle by next Wed, partner tech review the following Mon.

Vik (Eng Integrations): I'll list recommended instance SKUs (T4/A10x/etc.) and memory footprints per model size in the infra section.

ci-bot: Created subtask PART-4517.1 (infra matrix) assigned to Vik

Erin (Partnerships): Nice. Please put pre-reads in the repo under /docs/onboarding before Monday. I'll loop in LangChain + one reference SI for the review. Closing sync. :white_check_mark:
